_comment: Default keyboard shortcuts for the unified control web (see web/app.js). Actions reference policies BY NAME, not by index — names come from ControlService.status() at runtime, so this file survives whatever --policy set swap_experiment.py was started with (an unknown name shows as unbound, not an error). Edit this file directly to change v1 defaults; there is no in-page rebind UI yet.
_reserved_comment: Arrow keys are intentionally unbound in v1 — reserved for a future set_command(vx, vy, yaw) velocity-control method, which needs its own safety/limits design and explicit sign-off before it's added (see HANDOFF_control_web.md open question 5).
